sbar.background: The network stopped answering, with 100% of requests failing against a 0% baseline. The p95 latency is 2031 ms against a 26 ms baseline.
sbar.assessment: The root cause is an external outage of the payment network (confidence 0.93). The clearing log shows 'payment network timeout; item stays pending item_id=96'. The clearing worker and item 96 are healthy and not at fault, and no allowed action could fix the network, so the incident commander escalated it to the network operator itself.
sbar.recommendation: Follow up with the national payment network operator, who has been asked to restore their service. Do not quarantine the queued items, including item 96, because they will clear once the network answers; then monitor the backlog draining. The operations team should review the delayed settlement of the pending payments.
